using namespace std;

using u99 = bitset<128>;

const int MOD = 1000000007;
const int INV = 570000004;

inline int add(int a, int b) { return (a + b >= MOD) ? (a + b - MOD) : (a + b); }
inline int sub(int a, int b) { return (a < b) ? (a - b + MOD) : (a - b); }
inline long long mul(long long a, long long b) { return (a * b) % MOD; }

unordered_map<u99, int> name_map;
int n, dfs_counter, children[65536][128];

int dfs(u99 state) {
    auto it = name_map.find(state);
    if (it != name_map.end()) return it->second;
    int id = dfs_counter++;
    name_map[state] = id;
    for (int mask = 0; mask != (1 << n); ++mask) {
        u99 next_state = state;
        for (int j = 0; j != (1 << n); ++j) if (!next_state[j]) {
            for (int k = mask & j; k; k ^= k & -k) {
                if (state[j ^ (k & -k)]) {
                    next_state[j] = 1;
                    break;
                }
            }
        }
        children[id][mask] = dfs(next_state);
    }
    return id;
}

int prob[7][7], q_vals[7][128], dp[8][65536];

int main() {
    ios::sync_with_stdio(false);
    cin.tie(nullptr);
    
    cin >> n;
    dfs(1);
    
    for (int i = 0; i != n; ++i) {
        for (int j = 0; j != n; ++j) {
            cin >> prob[i][j];
            prob[i][j] = (int)mul(prob[i][j], INV);
        }
    }
    
    for (int i = 0; i != n; ++i) {
        for (int j = 0; j != (1 << n); ++j) {
            q_vals[i][j] = 1;

                int term = bit ? prob[k][i] : sub(1, prob[k][i]);
                q_vals[i][j] = (int)mul(q_vals[i][j], term);
            }
        }
    }
    
    dp[0][0] = 1;
    for (int i = 0; i != n; ++i) {
        for (int j = 0; j != dfs_counter; ++j) {
            for (int k = 0; k != (1 << n); ++k) {
                dp[i + 1][children[j][k]] = add(dp[i + 1][children[j][k]], 
                                                (int)mul(dp[i][j], q_vals[i][k]));
